guesses.reason: Small, fine-boned build with large upright triangular ears, a short tapered muzzle, and big dark round eyes are classic Chihuahua traits.
The predominantly white body with a black-and-tan tricolor head, a narrow white blaze, and a black body patch resembles a tricolor terrier pattern.
The slightly longer, wispy coat on the chest and tail, combined with large erect fringed ears and the tricolor pattern, hints at Papillon influence.

breed.appearance: A small, slender dog with a mostly white, slightly wiry medium-short coat lightly ticked with faint gray-tan speckles on the legs, a single bold black patch on the shoulder/side, and a curled-up tail patterned black and tan at the base. Its head is tricolor: a black mask over both eyes and cheeks with tan eyebrow dots and tan cheek markings, a narrow white blaze running up the forehead, a white speckled muzzle, and a black nose. It has very large, erect triangular ears that are tan on the inside and fringed, big round dark-brown eyes, and wears a teal collar with a silver bone-shaped tag attached to an orange leash.
breed.fun_fact: Chihuahuas may be tiny, but they have big personalities and often form devoted bonds with their favorite person!
